Campaign · Bengaluru, 2026

The autumn campaign

Woven slowly, worn for years.

Two co-ops in Bhagalpur, forty-one weavers, one price list. Every saree is paid for within seven days of leaving the loom — no middlemen, no seasonal discounting.

The campaign was shot over three days in our Bengaluru studio: no retouching, no studio lights beyond one window.
